children: MapletreeLog Treasury Company, a unit linked to Mapletree Logistics Trust
, has launched a 500 million yuan  ($74.5 million) three-year offshore yuan or dim sum bond sale at a yield of 2.10%, according to an updated term sheet on Tuesday.
MapletreeLog launched the senior unsecured fixed-rate notes  at 2.10%, tighter than initial price guidance at about 2.40%.
Order books were over 1.25 billion yuan.
The notes are expected to be rated BBB+ by Fitch. They will be issued under the company's S$3 billion ($2.37 billion) Euro Medium Term Securities Programme.
The notes are expected to mature on September 15, 2029.
Proceeds will be used for general corporate and working capital purposes, including refinancing existing borrowings of Mapletree Logistics Trust.
